mentions.name: Embar
mentions.description: A Python ORM inspired by Drizzle that provides type-safety on inputs and outputs with useful type hints, aiming to be simple for the 80-99% of common cases while letting users drop easily into raw SQL for the remainder.
mentions.problem: Python ORM options generally lack type-safety on inputs and outputs or useful type hints, and SQLAlchemy is hard to use if it is not your full-time job.
